insights.one_liner: Elsevier is the Amsterdam-based scientific publisher and analytics company owned by RELX; a recognised visa sponsor with a marketing internship needing no Dutch.

culture.text: Elsevier works in information and analytics for researchers and healthcare professionals, and is increasingly building AI tools for them.
A large company with about 9,500 staff in 2024, headquartered in Amsterdam and Philadelphia.
Its one open job here is a marketing and communications internship in Amsterdam.

open.text: Elsevier B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its current job here does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Staff grew from 6,900 in 2008 to 9,500 in 2024.
Revenue was GBP 3.06 billion in 2023, with operating income of GBP 1.165 billion.
It is launching AI products, such as ClinicalKey Nursing AI and LeapSpace for research.
